items.title: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends Oct. 16
items.summary: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit end on October 16. These savings for Founder and Investor Passes vanish after Friday. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station. Bring your toughest questions and make the day count for your business.
items.creator: TechCrunch Events

items.title: Volvo makes a bigger bet on Nvidia
items.summary: Volvo is leveling up its automated driving system through an expansion of its nearly decade-long partnership with Nvidia that will extend beyond its battery electric vehicles.
items.creator: Kirsten Korosec
